showcase.headline: Every claim, traced back to its source.
showcase.body: Skimr reads your PDFs, images, links and notes, then writes a literature review where every finding quotes the passage it came from.
showcase.caption: Example synthesis
showcase.quote: Employees working remotely three or more days a week reported lower commute-related stress.
showcase.interpretation_text: Across these studies, flexible work appears to support wellbeing, although most samples come from office-based roles.
